title: Why Do Miami's Roads Stand Up? 🎮 #GTA6 #shorts
description:
GTA 6 heads back to a fictional Miami. The real Miami has a party trick: along the Miami River, a row of drawbridges open on signal so boats can pass. Many are bascule bridges, from the French word for seesaw. Each road leaf pivots on a giant axle called a trunnion, and a massive counterweight behind the pivot balances it, so relatively small motors can lift tons of steel. By federal rule they open on signal, except during weekday rush hours.

Follow Hidden Mechanics for more everyday engineering, explained in under a minute.
